listing.name: Doom / Nugget Doom
listing.summary: Play Doom or Freedoom in Nugget Doom, with additional gameplay, control and display options.

steps.title: Choose your game data
steps.instruction: Use the matching IWAD from your own Doom installation or a freely available Freedoom IWAD. Pass -iwad followed by the quoted file path. Leave nugget-doom.pk3 in the extracted package. It supplies engine resources.

steps.title: Start Nugget Doom on Windows
steps.instruction: Extract the complete x64 ZIP. Run nugget-doom.exe from that directory or run nugget-doom-setup.exe to configure controls and video. The publisher also provides a separate 32-bit ZIP.

steps.title: Start Nugget Doom on Linux
steps.instruction: Make the x86-64 AppImage executable and run it with the IWAD. The 6.1.0 engine requires glibc 2.38 or later. If FUSE is unavailable, use --appimage-extract and run AppRun from the complete extracted directory.

steps.title: Start Nugget Doom on a Mac
steps.instruction: Extract the universal ZIP and keep the player, setup program, engine PK3 and soundfonts together. Run ./nugget-doom with your IWAD in Terminal. Both Intel and Apple Silicon slices of 6.1.0 require macOS 26 or later.

warnings: The publisher player can register a Discord link handler on startup. Installation, updates and user data stay with the upstream package or your own copy.
The packaged notices omit credits for some bundled engine assets. See the publisher’s Legalese section for those credits.

references.title: Preserve the profile with the matching IWAD
references.instruction: On Linux keep $XDG_DATA_HOME/nugget-doom, normally ~/.local/share/nugget-doom. It holds nugget-doom.cfg and per-IWAD savegames. Preserve your active profile, IWAD and add-ons before changing engine or package versions.

original_game_review.reason: The authored source/setup scope explicitly permits Doom or Freedoom originals, with per-IWAD game/save choices. This broad engine record is not scoped to one original game.
